name: Creamy Iced Coconut Coffee

ingredients.name: sweetened canned coconut cream, such as Coco López

instructions.primary_message: In a blender, combine cold brew concentrate, sweetened coconut cream, unsweetened coconut cream, ice, and salt. Pulse a few times to break the ice, then blend on high speed until a slushy consistency forms, 30 to 60 seconds. Pour into a glass and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: frozen drink, frozen coffee, iced coffee, cold brew, smoothie, coffee smoothie, coconut coffee, coconut milk

description: This blended iced coconut coffee is refreshing, creamy, and just sweet enough. It's made with cold brew concentrate and coconut cream for bold flavor and rich texture.
notes:
Notes: This recipe can easily be doubled.
I prefer the robust flavor of undiluted cold-brew concentrate in this drink, but if you like a milder drink, you can use regular cold-brew coffee. For an unsweetened version, omit the sweetened coconut cream and double the amount of unsweetened coconut cream.

Make-ahead and storage: Iced drinks are best enjoyed immediately after blending.
author: Laila Ibrahim
